name: filesystem-mcp
description: Filesystem MCP server for AI assistants. Search, read, edit, and manage local files in directories you choose.

interface.shortDescription: Read, search, edit and patch files in the folders you choose.
interface.longDescription: Gives your AI client file tools limited to the folders you allow. Secret files like .env and private keys stay hidden by default, deleting a folder or overwriting a file waits for your confirmation, and read-only mode removes every tool that changes files. Runs locally and sends no data anywhere.
